about_the_game:
This collaboration set was created to celebrate the 90th anniversary of the artist Yokoyama Mitsuteru's birth. It features a total of 15 CG portraits of 13 different rulers and wise leaders, such as Cao Cao and Zhuge Liang, from the manga "Romance of the Three Kingdoms", one of Yokoyama's representative works. These illustrations clearly demonstrate the appeal of the officers of "Romance of the Three Kingdoms".

Additional Officer CG Portraits
Jia Xu, Sima Yi (2 types), Zhou Yu, Zhuge Liang (2 types), Xu Shu, Cao Cao, Sun Quan, Zhang Jiao, Diaochan, Dong Zhuo, Pang Tong, Lu Xun, and Liu Bei.

How to Access
Set officers' CG portraits via Edit Original Officers or Edit Historical Officers.
To view the portraits, select Edit, Edit Original Officers, Create Original Officers or Change Original Officers, and then Portrait. Alternatively, select Edit, Edit Historical Officers, Edit Historical Officers again, Portrait, and then the "Special" tab.
Note: This content will only be available for purchase by 16:00 (UTC) on April 16th, 2025. You will still be able to enjoy the content you have purchased.
